hc.tour.picker.title: Choose a process
hc.tour.picker.text: Select the HC process you want to scan badges for. Only processes you have permission to manage are shown.
hc.tour.controls.title: Date, shift and process
hc.tour.controls.text: The production date and AM / PM shift are preselected from the clock and can be changed here. Use “Change process” to switch to another process; pending draft lines stay saved for this shift.
hc.tour.counters.title: Shift and draft counters
hc.tour.counters.text: Scheduled, Assigned, Leave and To assign summarize this shift's head count. Pending, Saved, No machine and Warnings track the current scan draft.
hc.tour.locked.title: Month locked
hc.tour.locked.text: After the 7th of each month, previous-month attendance is locked and cannot be saved.
hc.tour.scan.title: Scan badge
hc.tour.scan.text: This box stays focused automatically. Scan an employee badge (no Enter key needed) or type an employee ID and press Enter. Each scan picks the best eligible machine by MTR level and recent work history.
hc.tour.result.title: Last scan result
hc.tour.result.text: Shows the person just scanned, the assigned machine or activity, their MTR level and any warnings, together with an audio beep (one for clean, two for warning, low tone for error).
hc.tour.actions.title: Clear draft and Confirm
hc.tour.actions.text: Nothing is written to the database until you press Confirm. Lines with yellow warnings will ask for acknowledgement first. Clear draft removes pending lines only; saved records are never touched.
hc.tour.entries.title: Scanned draft list
hc.tour.entries.text: Every pending scan appears here. Use the drop-down list to change a person's machine manually, or press x to remove a line from the draft.
hc.tour.machines.title: Machine cards
hc.tour.machines.text: Machines with assigned people appear first, followed by dashed Leave and Elsewhere cards, and then machines without assignments. Each person shows their name and employee ID, MTR level badge, and saved or italic pending status.
hc.tour.missing.title: Not assigned yet
hc.tour.missing.text: Scheduled members of this process and shift who still have no machine and are not on full-day leave. Click any person to enter their ID and scan them in automatically.
